stories.notes: Story has empty acceptance criteria and no existing spec. Live preview across GO, UP, and MX platforms is a complex real-time feature requiring requirements elaboration first (openspec), followed by testability, security, and edge-case hardening (speckit). Both agents assigned; openspec runs first, speckit reviews its output.

agentContributions.notes: Story requests a new Live Preview capability for CMS content editing. No existing preview infrastructure found in the provided code. The useContent hook (236 callers) is the central attachment point — all Contentstack components resolve content through it. VCs derived solely from description since ACs are empty. Criteria are scoped to our side of the Contentstack API boundary.

Openspec provided empty acceptanceCriteria, so all criteria were authored from scratch based on the story title, description, and technical notes. CRITICAL: The context provider file path varies across codebases — 'ContentstackContext.ts' (upexpress), 'ContentstackContext.tsx' (gotransit), 'contentstackContext.tsx' (metrolinx). All criteria intentionally reference components by role (e.g., 'the Contentstack context provider', 'the content hook') rather than by file path to avoid the path-mismatch issue flagged in the review. CAVEAT: I was unable to read file contents; criteria are derived from the story description and the structural hints in technicalNotes (hook as central attachment point, context provider, content card interface, link component). If the actual implementations contain existing preview scaffolding or constraints not evident from paths alone, some criteria may need adjustment.
